review_type: Independent AI claim-consistency review of the manuscript, public prose, saved results and observations.
scope: Read-only review of scientific claims and accounting; no new model inference, no complete analysis or bootstrap recomputation, no human validation. Reviewer wrote only this report.
path_base: Repository root; all evidence paths below are relative.

claim_checks.finding: All four primary AP differences are negative with intervals crossing zero. All four primary 720-call policy contrasts have identical itemwise correctness, not merely equal totals. Prose explicitly says no added benefit established, preserves random/first-entropy results, and avoids population-equivalence claims.

claim_checks.claim: Full-position repeatability and retained initial failure
claim_checks.finding: The retained initial attempt stopped before benchmark inference after 24 actual synthetic calls. Its detailed gate was not serialized. The separately dated 48-call diagnosis is correctly distinguished from that initial observation. Its two probability-tolerance failures and maximum difference 1.2785692607653054e-05 agree with the report. The versioned amendment retains the threshold and uses stock logits_to_keep=0 for both models. Full-position repeatability is not described as parity with the rejected optimization. Completed checks are 28 per model, separate from failed/diagnostic calls.

claim_checks.claim: Conditional uncertainty and gate information boundary
claim_checks.finding: Two thousand paired-question percentile draws are described as conditional on observed ranks/allocations and descriptive/unadjusted; undefined draws are retained. No future-order observations or gold labels enter the budget gate. The 720-call pair policy allocates 2*240+3*80 calls; first-entropy allocates 240+4*120 calls.

The study is described as a same-Mac extension across two unequal-size model families and distinct Japanese/English tasks. It does not establish a causal model-family/language effect, general superiority, or contamination-free evaluation. Local prospective freezing is explicitly distinguished from independent preregistration and acknowledges known earlier null findings.

Saved-record replay and AI arithmetic review are distinguished from fresh inference and independent-machine replication. CHECKS accurately restricts independently recomputed bootstrap checks to the Phi-English primary contrast/components and primary 3-call accuracy contrast.

Human participants remain zero. The formative pilot is preparation only and remains local. No independent-machine inference or independent human benefit is claimed. Token/latency sums are described as offline bookkeeping, without an online speedup claim.

resolved_findings.before: five fixed token-to-meaning bindings in cyclic display order
resolved_findings.after: five cyclic display orders with fixed token-to-meaning bindings
resolved_findings.status: Resolved by root and verified in the reviewed README; no scientific or code change needed.

limits: This is an AI claim review, not independent human scientific review.
Existing data, stored results and the targeted source claims were inspected; a full bootstrap or inference rerun was outside scope.
No evidence from prepared future human or second-machine studies is counted as completed.
